## The blog

In this blog, I'm gonna post my own thoughts on various topics from machine
learning to mathematical physics.

## The author

I'm a mathematician and machine learning engineer.
My Ph.D. in mathematics is made at University of Bergen and
the alma mater is Saint-Petersburg State University where
I studied quantum field theory.
I'm excited about the relation between
the mathematics of information theory and theoretical physics.
